notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 - Jul 1, 2021
notes.notes:
This patch includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Added level names to the signposts in the level select screen.
[*]Added the ability to control overall constellation size in the constellation designer.
[*]Added a counter for the number of hops done in Wibble's jump rope minigame.
[*]Added a confirmation prompt when trying to exit the settings menu if there are unsaved changes.
[*]Added a hint about being able to edit favorited photos in the McMuney Box.
[*]Added a hint about being able to click on locked path signs for hints when selecting a level.
[*]Added a mention of holding the donut key longer to strengthen the throw in the donut toss minigame hint.
[*]Changed how Celestios' song pitch minigame can be replayed after finishing the quest. It is now started through dialogue rather than by interacting with the horn.
[*]Changed the portal from Dream's Doorstep to always activate level select, instead of returning you directly to the level when no new path or level unlocks are available.
[*]Adjusted Ray-tay's location on Dream's Doorstep slightly to make her easier to spot.
[*]Reduced the difficulty of Nekolar's crane game slightly by increasing movement and grab animation speed.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused performance hitches on Dream's Doorstep on some hardware configurations.
[*]Fixed an animation restarting in Wishling's book when the last page is clicked repeatedly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 - Jun 28, 2021
notes.notes:
This patch contains the following changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed gravity taking unscheduled breaks during Yawhawk's minigame. Bad fundamental force! No donut!
[*]Fixed a spelling error.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - Jun 24, 2021
notes.notes:
This patch contains the following changes:

[list]
[*]Added the ability to turn off time slow without waiting for the timer to run out.
[*]Added the ability to ask for quest hints from the initial quest acceptance dialog for Sonawing, Ray-tay, and Lord of the Sea.
[*]Expanded the pose table and quest list UIs to take up the whole height of the screen and no longer require scrolling.
[*]Changed the hover tool to be toggled by pressing the key instead of being only active while the key is held.
[*]Changed the zoom tutorial to allow proceeding without zooming all the way in.
[*]Fixed saved resolution and window size settings not applying automatically on game start. For existing players, this will take effect after the next time settings are saved.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the rhythm game music to get out of sync if time slow was used during the countdown.
[*]Fixed the game staying in a permanent paused state if you held F1 in the pause menu then released it after exiting the menu.
[*]Fixed clothing assigned as a result of quests resetting to default when leaving and returning to Dream's Doorstep.
[*]Fixed the Snowdrop Slopes achievement not being granted if you unlock it in the demo then continue the same save after upgrading to the full game.
[*]Fixed Justaplant remaining underground after returning to Dream's Doorstep on lower graphics settings.
[*]Fixed being able to throw donuts and Albie during the interactive part of the game's ending sequence.
[*]Fixed the colored music crystals puzzle on Snowdrop Slopes not being repeatable within a single trip if solved before the Sonawings are summoned.
[*]Fixed a case where Wishling could allow you to finish her quest even if you no longer have the requested photos.
[*]Fixed being unable to slow time while crouched.
[*]Fixed the Joyous Wibble animation not playing reliably.
[*]Fixed several grammar and flow issues in dialogues.
[*]Fixed the eyepatch clipping when equipped by Dracory.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Jun 21, 2021
notes.notes:
This patch includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Added support for using the time slow tool in rhythm games.
[*]Ensured that every pose is perfectable.
[*]Fixed some fictions not registering in photos when zoomed in very closely.
[*]Fixed Feffo race checkpoints being hard to see on low graphics settings.
[*]Fixed several spelling and grammar mistakes.
[*]Fixed photos of Oa's seasonal aspects not counting towards pose collection.
[*]Fixed the Chilling Hiraffe pose being missable.
[*]Fixed some photos not appearing as choices when selecting a photo to turn into a jigsaw.
[*]Fixed stickers not appearing in hanging paintings.
[*]Fixed the live score tool showing scores when targeting a fiction with no valid pose.
[*]Fixed the jailed Wullard lacking collision.
[*]Fixed ice statues on Snowdrop Slopes lacking collision.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Jun 18, 2021
notes.notes:
We have a bigger patch coming next week, but here's a hotfix mainly to resolve the Crockasnap minigame not registering success on lower graphical settings. Here are the changes included in this update:

[list]
[*]Added a hint about holding F1 to see all relevant help in any situation.
[*]Added the ability to start Grumbo's hard song from his dialog.
[*]Fixed the Crockasnap minigame not registering success on lower graphical settings (because some of the grass was hidden for performance reasons).
[*]Fixed the angle score for Olsy's photos being computed incorrectly.
[*]Fixed Molo's surrender pose not being perfectable.
[*]Fixed the confirmation UIs in the pause menu not being hidden when hitting Esc.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Jun 17, 2021
notes.notes:
This patch includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Added outlines to the jigsaw puzzle pieces and switched the initial jigsaw to a brighter image.
[*]Added the ability to turn Hunter's Sense on and off after receiving it.
[*]Added exact score labels to the in-level pose list.
[*]Improved the color scheme for scoreboards to better differentiate 9/10 and 10/10 poses.
[*]Improved Orashell's swimming pose hint.
[*]Improved the donut hint to clarify that holding the key lets you throw it further.
[*]Increased the chance of Jolly Flippers doing flips.
[*]Changed the default firework type to Double Burst.
[*]Adjusted the default graphics settings to depend on the machine. Note that this applies to new players only. If you are an existing player and are experiencing performance issues, please try the auto-detect feature in the graphics settings menu!
[*]Fixed an issue that would mistakenly accept savegames from the old festival demo, which aren't compatible, and leave the game in an invalid state.
[*]Fixed the Joyous Wibble pose being missable.
[*]Fixed the Exhausted Dopey Needles pose being missable.
[*]Fixed an issue that could invalidate Qumulo poses when his illusion is in the frame.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause the final photo taken during the ending sequence to not save.
[*]Fixed the magnet in Crockasnap's minigame being rotatable.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause Crockasnap's minigame to not register a win.
[*]Fixed customization images (snowflake, jack-o'-lantern, etc.) losing image quality after multiple resaves.
[*]Fixed the lone wanderer Wullard having idle thoughts intended for guard Wullards.
[*]Fixed an issue that could allow the player to get stuck or fall through the world in Snowdrop Slopes.
[*]Fixed the magnet puzzle in the Glittering Caves triggering too early.
[*]Fixed Jo'keel's flip being triggerable only once per trip.
[*]Fixed cursor sparkles being offset from the cursor on ultra-widescreen resolutions.
[*]Fixed a performance issue near Bigheart's hub on Dream's Doorstep.
[*]Fixed angry Kroixes sometimes being scored as Kalm Kroix.
[*]Fixed the Winter Oa puzzle unintentionally being solvable in sunny weather.
[*]Fixed several grammar and spelling mistakes.
[/list]

Extra thanks to everyone who reported issues, gave feedback, or streamed their play session!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Jun 15, 2021
notes.notes:
This second patch includes the following changes:

- Fixed a crash after the tutorial on early versions of DirectX 11 (Windows 7/8/8.1).
- Added support for vertically inverting mouse look.
- Fixed several spelling and grammar mistakes.
- Fixed an issue that would make some minigames unbeatable if you start them after hitting the photo limit.
- Fixed Beato's Woken Up pose not being scored.
- Fixed double-clicking on travelling Sonawings resulting in a permanent fade-out.
- Improved the hint text for Kuki Bird's Pecking pose.
- Made the lawnmowing minigame slightly easier by increasing the radius of the lawnmower.
- Adjusted the auto-detected graphical settings to prioritize performance slightly.

Hope you're enjoying the game! If you run into any issues, don't hesitate to let us know in the Steam discussions, on [url=https://discord.gg/V2JrR2pcBd]our discord[/url], or through email (support@alekongame.com).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Jun 13, 2021
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed an issue that caused the level select menu to get into a non-interactable state.
- Fixed an issue with the snowflake designer cursor being offset when played in windowed mode.
- Fixed several typos, grammar, and pronoun mistakes.
- Fixed Ray-tay's hanging pose not being attainable at 10/10 score.
- Made the Snowdrop Slopes cave path hint slightly clearer.

Note that there was also a release day patch that changed the Wullard quest storyline to feature a much more wholesome narrative, although it is still savegame-compatible.
